# appgatesdp_appliance (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_interface` (Attributes) The details of the Client connection interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_interface))
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the Appliance. It's used by other Appliances to communicate with and identify this Appliances. Set it to "automatic.hostname.assignment" for cloud appliances in order for it to automatically configure the hostname on activation.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `networking` (Attributes) Networking configuration of the system. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networking))

### Optional

- `admin_interface` (Attributes) The details of the admin connection interface. Required on Controllers and LogServers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--admin_interface))
- `connection_broker` (Attributes) Connection Broker settings. Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_broker))
- `connector` (Attributes) Connector settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector))
- `controller` (Attributes) Controller settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controller))
- `customization` (String) Customization assigned to this Appliance.
- `gateway` (Attributes) Gateway settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateway))
- `healthcheck_server` (Attributes) Healthcheck Server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--healthcheck_server))
- `hostname_aliases` (List of String) Hostname aliases. They are added to the Appliance certificate as Subject Alternative Names so it is trusted using different IPs or hostnames. Requires manual certificate renewal to apply changes to the certificate.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `log_forwarder` (Attributes) LogForwarder settings. LogForwarder collects audit logs from the appliances in the given sites and sends them to the given endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_forwarder))
- `log_server` (Attributes) Log Server settings. Log Server collects audit logs from all the appliances and stores them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_server))
- `metrics_aggregator` (Attributes) Metrics Aggregator settings. It collects metrics from the appliances in the given sites and provides Prometheus APIs for consumption. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_aggregator))
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `ntp` (Attributes) NTP configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ntp))
- `ping` (Attributes) Rules for allowing ping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ping))
- `portal` (Attributes) Portal settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal))
- `prometheus_exporter` (Attributes) Prometheus Exporter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prometheus_exporter))
- `rsyslog_destinations` (Attributes List) Rsyslog destination settings to forward appliance logs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rsyslog_destinations))
- `site` (String) Site assigned to the Appliance.
- `snmp_server` (Attributes) SNMP Server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snmp_server))
- `ssh_server` (Attributes) SSH server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_server))
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `telemetry_aggregator` (Attributes) TelemetryAggregator settings. It aggregates telemetry from all the appliances and exports it to the configured destinations. Supported in API versions: v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_aggregator))

### Read-Only

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether the Appliance is activated or not. If it is not activated, it won't be accessible by the Clients.
- `collective_replication` (Attributes) Collective Replication settings. Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collective_replication))
- `created` (String) Create date.
- `pending_certificate_renewal` (Boolean) Whether the Appliance is pending certificate renewal or not. Should be true for a very short period on certificate renewal.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `site_name` (String) Name of the Site for this Appliance. For convenience only.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
- `version` (Number) Peer version of the Appliance.

Required:

<a id="nestedatt--portal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `portal`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Portal is enabled on this appliance or not.
- `external_profiles` (Attributes List) Profiles from other Collectives to use in the Portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal--external_profiles))
- `http_redirect` (Boolean) Automatic 80->443 redirection for Portal.
- `https_ciphers` (List of String) The type of TLS ciphers to allow. See: https://www.openssl.org/docs/man1.0.2/apps/ciphers.html for all supported ciphers. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `https_p12` (Attributes) PKCS12 object with X.509 certificate and private key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal--https_p12))
- `profiles` (List of String) Names of the profiles in this Collective to use in the Portal.
- `proxy_p12s` (Attributes List) P12 files for proxying traffic to HTTPS endpoints. Required when Portal is enabled and no subdomain mappings are configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal--proxy_p12s))
- `proxy_ports` (List of Number) Ports that can be proxied via Portal.
- `sign_in_customization` (Attributes) Visual customizations to make on the Portal sign-in page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal--sign_in_customization))
- `subdomain_mappings` (Attributes List) Maps short public subdomain aliases to internal app domains, allowing clients to reach internal resources without requiring those domains to be publicly resolvable. Traffic to the alias is proxied through the client's VPN session to the configured app domain. Supported in API versions: v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal--subdomain_mappings))

- `profile_name` (String) Profile name parsed from the given URL.

<a id="nestedatt--portal--sign_in_customization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `portal.sign_in_customization`

Optional:

- `auto_redirect` (Boolean) If enabled and the user lands on the Portal sign-in page by entering an endpoint URL on the browser, it will be redirected to the endpoint automatically after successfully signing in instead of the Portal Client overview page.
- `background_color` (String) Changes the background color on the sign-in page. In hexadecimal format.
- `background_image` (String) Changes the background image on the sign-in page. Must be in PNG, JPEG or GIF format.
- `logo` (String) Changes the logo on the sign-in page. Must be in PNG, JPEG or GIF format.
- `text` (String) Adds a text to the sign-in page.
- `text_color` (String) Changes the text color on the sign-in page. In hexadecimal format.


<a id="nestedatt--portal--subdomain_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `portal.subdomain_mappings`

Optional:

- `app_domain` (String) The fully-qualified internal app domain that traffic is proxied to. Does not need to be publicly resolvable. It is resolved through the client's VPN tunnel.
- `subdomain` (String) The leftmost DNS label of the public alias (e.g. 'crm'). Must be a valid DNS label: letters, digits, and hyphens only, no leading or trailing hyphen, maximum 63 characters.
- `verify_upstream_certificate` (Boolean) Whether to verify the app domain's TLS certificate when proxying. Set to false if the app server uses a self-signed or internally-signed certificate. Defaults to true.
